vars.name: PrimeNG
vars.add_cmd: import the component's module in the standalone component's `imports`
vars.ng_form_import_lines:
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';

context: PrimeNG components are imported per standalone component — there is no global module to register
rules: Import only the PrimeNG components a component actually uses; never barrel-import the suite

scaffold.$comment: @angular/animations is installed alongside PrimeNG because the Angular CLI starter does not include it and PrimeNG peer-depends on it — `npm install primeng` alone fails to resolve. Verified with matching majors (primeng@20 + @angular/animations@^20.3.0 on Angular 20), which installed and built cleanly; the unpinned @latest trio is self-consistent on a Node new enough for the current CLI.
